description: BLM Ground Transportation Linear Features (GTLF), Public Display motorized layers: roads + trails managed for public or limited public motorized use, with OHV designation (open/limited/closed/unassessed), limitation text, and seasons extracted from limitation free text where parseable.

sources.name: BLM_Natl_GTLF_Public_Display layers 0-3
sources.method: esridump --jsonlines per layer (no bulk national GDB is published for the Public Display filter)

stable_key: source_id (= GlobalID when present, else per-layer OBJECTID — OBJECTIDs are NOT stable across BLM republishes; rte_cn_stability treats GTLF churn as expected)
notes: Field names verified 2026-08-03 against MapServer/0: GlobalID, OBJECTID, ROUTE_PRMRY_NM, PLAN_OHV_ROUTE_DSGNTN ('Open'/'Limited'), OHV_ROUTE_DSGNTN_LIM, OHV_DSGNTN_LIM_EXPLAIN (free text), PLAN_SEASON_RSTRCT_CODE ('YES'/'NO'), OBSRVE_SRFCE_TYPE, GIS_MILES. Layer hints: 0=roads open, 1=roads limited, 2=trails open, 3=trails limited; explicit PLAN_OHV_ROUTE_DSGNTN wins over the hint. SEASON POLARITY TRAP: live OHV_DSGNTN_LIM_EXPLAIN is overwhelmingly CLOSURE-phrased ('Closed 12/1- 4/15' — 100/100 sampled date-bearing values), but the shared season parser emits OPEN windows; text matching the normalizer's CLOSURE_HINT (closed/closure/closes/closing/prohibit*) therefore NEVER emits a seasons attr — it lands in the review queue (field ohv_dsgntn_lim_explain_closure) and the raw text still ships in limitation_text. Client styles on 'designation': open→#7CB342, limited→#FFC107, closed/unassessed→#8A8F98 dashed.
